title: tensorfs-contract-v1
description: A tensor layout contract: the declarative, versioned input that identifies a file's layout and directs its chunking seams.

name.description: The handle: <producer>.<format>, as gen-worker spells layout contracts.

sets.description: Named removable tensor sets, by pattern.

pattern.description: Literal text with {i} holes, each matching one non-negative integer without leading zeros. Two adjacent holes, or a digit immediately after a hole, are ambiguous and refuse.

role.description: Spelling-independent identity, carrying the same holes in the same order as `pattern`.

pattern.description: The tensor's spelling in the file.

dtypes.description: Accepted dtype names (safetensors spelling; ggml type names for GGUF). Empty accepts any.

fusion.description: A fusion along the outermost axis: `groups` repetitions of the `parts` cycle. groups=1 is plain stacking; groups>1 is an interleave (H3's head-major qkv is 56). Runs below 1 MiB produce no cut points.

axis.description: Only the outermost axis is a byte concatenation.

role.description: Role suffix in the split packaging. Empty only as the sole part of an interleaved slice.
